answer: Merge data views first, then each lane fixes its own imports at catch-up
context: DV3a moves 92 files. Git merges it cleanly with other lanes, but their imports to the old paths break.
note: Do not hold Proposal page for this; a catch-up merge is cheaper than a wait.

options.label: Merge data views before Proposal page and Filter rules
options.consequence: Both lanes wait for the data views PR

options.label: Merge data views last
options.consequence: Each lane rewrites its imports to the new paths before it ships

question: Which lane merges first, given that DV3a moves 92 files?
recommended: Merge data views before Proposal page and Filter rules
reply: Data views merges first. Proposal page and Filter rules fix their imports at their next catch-up merge.
